I have a small wheat plot of 0.16 hectares that I am renting, so I need to get a good harvest to pay the landlord and still have grain for my family. I will apply some DAP and urea fertilizer from the cooperative because without it the wheat grows poorly on this soil, though I cannot afford the full amount the extension workers recommend. I will plant my own saved seed since improved wheat seed is too expensive and hard to find, and my family will do all the work with our oxen—ploughing, planting, weeding, and harvesting—because the plot is small and hiring labor costs money we do not have. I will not use chemicals for pests or irrigation since wheat here grows with the meher rains and we have no pump.
